remarks: 后续裁切显示，未经引擎验收
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EMPTY progress-track geometry reference. Generate ONLY the independent FILL layer fitting inside its frame. Preserve1536x1024canvas and center(768,512). Remove BOTH border outlines and the ivory empty-track backing COMPLETELY. NO frame, brown rim, white well, text, numbers, ticks, gradients, glow or shadow. One green flat strip, sparse clean watercolor wash INSIDE strip, not noisy.
